cross_memberships.reason: arXiv RT explicitly includes representations of algebras, providing the associative-algebra connection alongside group representations.
arXiv QA includes quantum groups and diagrammatic algebra; associative-algebra placement records their algebraic methods, not equality with all associative algebras.
arXiv OA studies algebras of Hilbert-space operators, supporting a connection to operator theory alongside functional analysis.
arXiv MG explicitly includes discrete and convex geometry, supporting this additional specific geometric placement.

nodes.canonical_title: Inner models, large cardinals and determinacy
nodes.title_zh: 内模型、大基数与决定性

activity_evidence.evidence_summary: The programme explicitly covers new inner-model results, large cardinals, determinacy and forcing axioms. The two weeks are counted as one organized event group.

Steel records two lectures on large cardinals, determinacy and inner models, explicitly limiting the inner-model coverage to the comparison lemma. This is a distinct JMM tutorial, not a mirror of the Vienna workshop.

nodes.regional_relevance: Inner models compare axiomatic set-theoretic universes and large-cardinal/determinacy strength; this is foundational logic, not an application-specific mathematical theory.

nodes.title_zh: 模型论温和性与 o-极小结构

activity_evidence.evidence_summary: The meeting studies model-theoretic tameness of groups and fields and related classification questions. Only this short audit summary and bibliographic metadata are redistributed; the restricted report PDF is not copied.
The authors investigate invariant types and weakly o-minimal types, and apply definable shifts to counting models. The current v2, not the search engine's old v1 metadata, is registered.

nodes.regional_relevance: Tameness concerns definable sets and types in first-order structures, including o-minimal and weakly o-minimal settings; it lies within model theory.

nodes.title_zh: 高阶范畴模型与协调性

activity_evidence.evidence_summary: A higher-dimensional rewriting framework develops coherence calculations and a model structure for strict higher categories.
The article constructs higher categories through complete Segal-space fibrations and compares quasi-category constructions. It is independent of the polygraphs monograph.

nodes.regional_relevance: Polygraphs and Segal-space models study higher categorical composition, coherence and homotopical presentation.

nodes.canonical_title: Cubical type theory and univalent higher structures
nodes.title_zh: 立方类型论与单价高阶结构

cross_memberships.reason: Univalent and cubical type theories are formal logical foundations with identity types and computational rules.
The HoTT source interprets types through homotopy and constructs higher inductive types; the cubical source studies their higher-dimensional boundaries.

activity_evidence.evidence_summary: The collaborative book supplies the established connection between identity types, homotopy, higher inductive types and univalent foundations.

The paper treats contortion and Kan boundary-filling algorithms for cubical type theories supporting univalence and higher inductive types. It distinguishes heuristic automation from the undecidable general Kan problem.

nodes.regional_relevance: Cubical type theory models higher identity and homotopy structures; its primary placement is higher structures with cross-membership in logic and algebraic topology.

cross_memberships.reason: Representation invariants are categorified using module categories, functors and Grothendieck groups, making categorical structure part of the research object.

activity_evidence.evidence_summary: The programme discusses categorical representations, KLR algebras and relations between superalgebra categorifications, including research talks about subquotients of category O.
Rui and Song use a Grothendieck group of filtered Brauer-category representations to categorify a highest-weight module, with explicit characteristic restrictions.

nodes.regional_relevance: Categorification replaces representation-theoretic invariants by categories, with algebra actions and Grothendieck groups linking representation theory and category theory.

nodes.canonical_title: Modular representations, blocks and tensor-triangular methods
nodes.title_zh: 模表示、块与张量三角方法

cross_memberships.reason: The Brauer source studies blocks and defect groups of finite groups; the finite-group structure is essential to the represented objects.

activity_evidence.evidence_summary: The article completes the remaining implication of Brauer's height-zero conjecture for odd primes; it supports ongoing study of finite-group blocks and defect groups, not a claim that this named conjecture remains open.
Research talks connect tensor-triangular methods with modular representation theory, homotopy and algebraic geometry. This organized programme is independent of the Brauer article.

nodes.regional_relevance: Blocks and defect groups are central to finite-group modular representations; tensor-triangular geometry supplies additional categorical methods.

nodes.canonical_title: Prismatic cohomology and integral p-adic geometry
nodes.title_zh: 棱柱上同调与整 p 进几何

cross_memberships.reason: The foundational source attaches a ringed prismatic site to a p-adic formal scheme, while crystals and cohomology are geometric constructions on that site.

activity_evidence.evidence_summary: Prismatic sites of p-adic formal schemes unify several integral p-adic cohomology theories. The article's scope is read from its abstract, not its apparently unrelated publisher MSC field.

Tsuji explains a q-Higgs description of prismatic crystals and their cohomology, including Frobenius and Nygaard filtrations. This is a distinct research contribution, not the foundational paper's mirror.

nodes.regional_relevance: Prismatic sites and crystals connect arithmetic p-adic cohomology with formal-scheme geometry, giving legitimate number-theoretic and algebraic-geometric placements.

nodes.canonical_title: Geometrization of the local Langlands correspondence
nodes.title_zh: 局部 Langlands 对应的几何化

cross_memberships.reason: The correspondence constructs parameters associated with representations; the geometric framework acts on sheaf categories tied to local representation theory.
The geometric side uses stacks of bundles and motivic or l-adic sheaves; these are algebraic-geometric structures in the cited construction.

activity_evidence.evidence_summary: The work extends the Fargues–Scholze setting from l-adic to motivic sheaves and addresses independence of l of constructed parameters.
Imai provides a separately authored exposition of Fargues–Scholze geometrization. It is counted as a survey source group, not as an independent proof of the correspondence.

nodes.regional_relevance: Local Langlands geometrization studies local-field representation parameters via sheaves on geometric stacks, connecting arithmetic, representation theory and algebraic geometry.

activity_evidence.evidence_summary: The programme addresses birational methods, Cremona groups, K-moduli and mirror symmetry. This node uses its birational content; canonical metrics are a separate geometric direction.
Birkar studies birational boundedness for polarized projective varieties under controlled singularities and positivity hypotheses. The audit does not remove those conditions or verify the proof.

nodes.regional_relevance: Birational boundedness studies algebraic varieties, linear systems and controlled singularities; it is separate from the analytic construction of canonical metrics.

nodes.canonical_title: Derived moduli of sheaves and Stokes data
nodes.title_zh: 层与 Stokes 数据的导出模空间

cross_memberships.reason: Derived moduli constructions use infinity-categorical coefficients, dg-categories and Hochschild homology, as stated in the two source abstracts.

activity_evidence.evidence_summary: The paper constructs locally geometric derived moduli of Stokes data. It is the replacement for the derived-moduli portion split out of the older paper; the superseded title is not treated as a second independent work.
Casals and Li construct functions on derived sheaf moduli with Legendrian microsupport using Hochschild homology and geometry of Lagrangian fillings.

nodes.regional_relevance: Derived stacks of sheaves and Stokes data belong to algebraic geometry and use higher-categorical coefficients and homotopical constructions.

nodes.title_zh: 色同伦与代数 K 理论

cross_memberships.reason: Both sources study algebraic K-theory and its behavior under chromatic localization; ring and category hypotheses remain distinct.

activity_evidence.evidence_summary: The work characterizes certain Lubin–Tate theories and obtains redshift for algebraic K-theory of E-infinity rings. Ring-spectrum hypotheses are retained in this source audit.
Ramzi studies rigid symmetric-monoidal stable categories and gives counterexamples to a categorical analogue of redshift. This is not a contradiction to the differently scoped ring-spectrum theorem.

nodes.regional_relevance: Chromatic localizations of spectra and redshift questions connect stable algebraic topology and algebraic K-theory; categorical extensions require different hypotheses.

cross_memberships.reason: The lecture series derives applications to symplectic manifolds from moduli of Floer trajectories; the symplectic placement records that geometric setting.

activity_evidence.evidence_summary: The seminar progresses from spectra and Morse theory to Floer homotopy, showing a concrete reading and research programme at the intersection of stable homotopy and symplectic topology.

Abouzaid discusses recovering generalized-homology information from higher-dimensional Floer solution spaces and recent technical advances, with further structures explicitly described as work in progress.

nodes.regional_relevance: Floer homotopy extracts stable homotopical information from moduli of trajectories, connecting algebraic topology and symplectic geometry.

activity_evidence.evidence_summary: IAS 的 Sesum 报告介绍多重翘曲积度量中的开放初值集合，其 Ricci 流以广义柱面作为奇性模型。
2023 年 Oberwolfach 微分几何研讨会将 Ricci/Kähler 流与扩张 Ricci 孤立子列为实质报告主题。

nodes.regional_relevance: 研究几何演化在曲率集中处的局部模型、孤立子与极限几何。所选证据覆盖广义柱面奇性和 Ricci 孤立子研究，不宣称已经分类所有奇性。

nodes.canonical_title: Kähler–Einstein metrics and canonical complex geometry
nodes.title_zh: Kähler–Einstein 度量与典范复几何

activity_evidence.evidence_summary: 研讨会专门报告 Fano 簇族上的 Kähler–Einstein 度量，提供近年活动依据；ICM 章节另解释概率构造与变分观点。

nodes.regional_relevance: 以典范度量的存在、变化及构造联系复几何、Fano 簇与概率方法。与 Ricci 流奇性保留交叉联系，但作为不同研究问题登记。

nodes.canonical_title: Scattering and long-time dynamics of nonlinear dispersive equations
nodes.title_zh: 非线性色散方程的散射与长时间动力学
aliases: 色散 PDE 的长时间行为

activity_evidence.evidence_summary: IAS 合作报告记录 2024 年 6 月对 MMT 模型的 Sobolev 增长研究；实线上的散射在报告中仍作为后续问题。
Park 的论文在明确的维数与权重范围内证明径向散焦能量临界非齐次 NLS 的整体适定性和散射。

nodes.regional_relevance: 围绕非线性色散方程的长期正则性、Sobolev 范数增长和散射展开。区分已有定理与报告中的待研究问题，不将所有模型视为具有相同散射行为。

nodes.canonical_title: Singularity formation and long-time dynamics in fluid PDEs
nodes.title_zh: 流体方程的奇性形成与长时间动力学
aliases: Euler 方程动力学与流体奇性

activity_evidence.evidence_summary: Elgindi 的分析报告讨论二维 Euler 解的长期演化、扭转稳定性、细丝化与 Sobolev 增长。
Buckmaster 在波湍流合作年会报告流体奇性、不稳定 PDE 解及计算辅助证明方法。

nodes.regional_relevance: 研究 Euler 等流体方程中稳定性、细丝化、范数增长及奇性机制，并连接计算辅助证明。这里不声称解决 Navier–Stokes 正则性问题。

aliases: 随机 PDE 的重整化

activity_evidence.evidence_summary: SLMath 研究项目聚焦 SPDE 解理论、正则性结构、仿控制方法、普适性及量子场论联系。
Duch 在 SISSA 的研究课程以 KPZ、随机量子化和流方程方法讲授亚临界奇异 SPDE 的重整化。

nodes.regional_relevance: 研究粗糙噪声导致的非线性乘积、解理论与重整化，并与普适性和随机量子化相连。研究课程用于证明方向活跃，不单独作为新定理证明。

activity_evidence.evidence_summary: Oberwolfach 研讨会讨论高维极值、稀疏表示及多元和时间序列的统计推断。
Learning the Universe 年会报告利用非线性模拟进行可扩展隐式似然推断，包含大体积宇宙学数据的高维应用。

nodes.regional_relevance: 研究维数增长、稀疏结构或不可显式计算似然时的统计推断。此处选取高维极值与模拟驱动推断为两个有证据的活动切面，不把应用案例当作整个统计领域的代表。

activity_evidence.evidence_summary: JMM 的 AMS 专题场次以极值和概率组合学研究报告组成，说明两个方面的具体研究对象。
SLMath 的图论研讨会结合极值、概率与结构方法，安排介绍性讲座及近期成果研究报告。

nodes.regional_relevance: 以满足给定性质的组合对象的极端规模、典型性质及图结构为核心。两个独立研究活动都明确讨论近年问题与研究报告，而不是仅提供学科目录名称。

nodes.canonical_title: Quantitative structure and generalizations in additive combinatorics
nodes.title_zh: 加性组合中的定量结构与推广

activity_evidence.evidence_summary: Kelley 与 Meka 的 IAS 报告深入讨论三项等差数列问题中改进的定量界及其证明方法。
Pham 的 Stanford 报告介绍小倍增结构问题的图论方法，以及经典加性组合结果的非交换和组合推广。

nodes.regional_relevance: 研究算术级数、小倍增集合与群外组合结构中的定量定理。三项等差数列界与小倍增结构推广是不同工作，不重复登记为两个宏区节点。

nodes.canonical_title: Tensor-network methods for quantum many-body states
nodes.title_zh: 量子多体态的张量网络方法

activity_evidence.evidence_summary: IPAM 研讨会集中讨论张量网络结构、纠缠、量子多体建模以及与量子计算的比较。
Watanabe 与 Ueda 提出包含纠缠重整化的张量网络结构搜索，并在具体自旋模型中检验能量、保真度和纠缠熵。

nodes.regional_relevance: 利用张量网络组织量子多体态与纠缠结构，并研究网络结构选择和可计算性。保留其数学物理与科学计算的交叉性，但只登记一个规范方向。

nodes.title_zh: Liouville 共形场论的严格构造
aliases: 概率方法与 Liouville 场论

activity_evidence.evidence_summary: Guillarmou 在 IHES 报告 Liouville 共形场论的数学构造及结构常数、Virasoro 共形块的分解。
Ang 的论文研究 Liouville 场论曲面的量子缝合与 SLE，并证明边界 BPZ 方程。

nodes.regional_relevance: 用概率、分析与曲面几何建立 Liouville 共形场论及其与量子曲面、SLE 的联系。登记明确的严格理论方向，不将物理启发关系自动标为证明。

activity_evidence.evidence_summary: INI 项目报告记录材料表征与波散射研究活动，并讨论多重散射成像和波速重建等反问题。
Cheng 与 Dong 的论文给出二维无相位弹性散射数据的唯一性结果及刚性障碍物形状、位置的迭代重建。

nodes.regional_relevance: 研究由散射或测量数据恢复障碍物、介质及材料结构，兼顾唯一性与重建算法。波成像作为应用入口，保留问题本身的数学条件。

nodes.title_zh: 保持结构的几何数值积分

activity_evidence.evidence_summary: Acta Numerica 综述分析分裂与复合方法的阶条件、几何性质、高振荡问题及 PDE 应用，并比较具体算法。
Munthe-Kaas 研究对称空间上的几何积分器，使用 Lie 三重系统与典范操作处理球面、Grassmann 流形等空间。

nodes.regional_relevance: 研究保留几何结构的时间离散方法，当前证据覆盖分裂与复合算法以及对称空间上的积分器。不是声称整个几何积分领域首次出现于近五年。
